isolation: No legacy LLX or thermodynamic model code imported.

fitting_declaration.parameter_form: Directed SAT/MONO/NMP tau=a+b/T; directed pairs involving DI or POLY are isothermal tau at 298.15 K with b fixed exactly zero; tau_ii=0
fitting_declaration.initialization: all fitted values zero; deterministic scipy.optimize.least_squares
fitting_declaration.fit_residual: ln(x_i gamma_i)^R-ln(x_i gamma_i)^E for raw-active components positive in both phases

dependencies.restriction: numerical runtime only; no opencosmorspy or thermodynamic code

holdout_design.Coto: all four toluene rows plus table orders 2, 9, 13
holdout_design.family_holdout: unavailable; DI/POLY only occur at the Coto anchor

solver_diagnostics.estimation_class: regularization-constrained estimation; not an identifiability claim

measurement_only_jacobian.practical_warning: Measurement-only local sensitivity is ill-conditioned; pseudo-covariance uncertainties are diagnostic, not confidence intervals.

temperature_evidence.25 C: five-family Coto anchor plus SAT/MONO/NMP analogues
temperature_evidence.50 C: SAT/MONO/NMP analogue interpolation only; DI/POLY NOT_CALCULABLE
temperature_evidence.75 C: NOT_CALCULABLE for DI/POLY and outside analogue evidence

limitations: DI/POLY interactions are isothermal at 298.15 K and unsupported away from that anchor.
No phase amounts: validation feed is an unweighted midpoint and is not phase-split validation.
Nonconverged flashes are reported separately and are not counted as topology predictions.
